content_sections.heading: NIF Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 10 vacancies are available - 1 for Scientist D, 4 for Scientist C, and 5 for Scientist B.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIF Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 29-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIF to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for NIF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the National Innovation Foundation India (NIF), a premier organization focusing on research and innovation. It offers various scientific posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for NIF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts available under the NIF Recruitment 2026 are for Scientist positions, including Scientist D, Scientist C, and Scientist B across different levels.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in NIF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies announced for the Scientist posts in the National Innovation Foundation India recruitment drive for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for NIF Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The last date for eligible candidates to submit their online applications for the NIF Scientist posts is 29 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply early.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for NIF Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the National Innovation Foundation India Scientist Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Scientist posts at NIF?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Scientist D is 40 years, while for Scientist C and Scientist B, it is 35 years. Age relaxation may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum qualification required for NIF Scientist posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the NIF Scientist posts must hold a graduate degree. Specific qualifications for each post should be checked in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website for NIF Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for National Innovation Foundation India (NIF) recruitment and career-related information is www.nif.org.in. All updates will be posted there.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for NIF Scientist vacancies?
faq.answer: The job location for the NIF Scientist vacancies is Gandhinagar, Gujarat, with the pincode 382650. It is a full-time research position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for Scientist posts at NIF?
faq.answer: The salary for Scientist posts at NIF will be as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC). Specific pay levels are mentioned for Scientist D, C, and B.
